anchors.K_vs_U_and_K_vs_T: IMPROVED_OVER_X iff K's arm-local wrist AND elbow max(entry, exit, peak) steps are each lower than X's AND K's total wrist+elbow flicks <= X's (X = W136 U, W137 T); reported findings, they do not raise the CASE

attribution_rule: arm-local (clavicle_l frame) wrist/elbow motion is identical in the raw and the projected views by construction (same upperarm_l/lowerarm_l local rotations, same bone lengths), so any arm-local failure is attributed to the RAW GENERATOR's arm rotations. World-trajectory differences raw vs projected are attributed to PARENT CONTEXT (split into shoulder translation and parent orientation). If the projected world/arm-local continuity fails but the raw world continuity is usable AND raw-minus-projected > 100 mm at a failing frame, the failure is attributed to FROZEN-PARENT PROJECTION; if both fail, to the RAW GENERATOR; if neither or the evidence conflicts, UNKNOWN. (W138: projected = PROXY_B 77-joint locals with only LeftArm/LeftForeArm local rotations from the raw output, Kimodo FK, model space.)

case_rule.A: all mechanical gates pass AND GENERATED_EFFECT AND Q1-Q8 pass (unattainable here: Q8 declared NOT REVIEWED)
case_rule.B: a valid model Action exists (all mechanical gates pass) but NO_GENERATED_EFFECT or any of Q1-Q8 fails (improvement absent, unproven or review incomplete)
case_rule.C: real inference executed but: decoder/projection refusal (RIG_PROJECTION_FAILED), M4 fails, any of M1-run, M2, M3, M5, M6, M7, M11, M12 fails, projected unusable continuity (any K arm-local wrist or elbow entry/exit/peak step in 171->172 .. 199->200 > 100 mm), or raw full-body continuity UNUSABLE (RAW_RULE)
case_rule.D: declaration/instrument changed or model output preceded the declaration (DECLARATION_INVALID); a negative control does not fail closed (M10); integrity (M9) fails; the matched control Kc != B (M8) (INTEGRITY_FAILED)
case_rule.STOP: preflight not OK (STATE_CHANGED / DATA_BLOCKED / ACCESS_BLOCKED / RESOURCE_BLOCKED / REPRESENTATION_BLOCKED / CONDITIONING_BLOCKED) or the vendor conditioning refuses the declared keyframes before any sample exists -> the named STOP
case_rule.precedence: STOP > D > C > B > A; a mechanical PASS, synthetic PASS or a video file alone never yields A

generated_effect_rule: GENERATED_EFFECT iff max over Action 172..199 of max(|elbow_K - elbow_Kc|, |wrist_K - wrist_Kc|) (world, fresh readback) >= 10 mm; otherwise NO_GENERATED_EFFECT

quality_criteria.Q1: boundary continuity: K arm-local (clavicle_l frame) wrist AND elbow entry (171->172) and exit (199->200) steps each <= 2 x B's corresponding step + 10 mm
quality_criteria.Q2: no reversal flicks (consecutive steps both > 20 mm with negative dot) of the arm-local wrist or elbow in 171->172 .. 199->200
quality_criteria.Q3: interior smoothness: K arm-local wrist peak step <= 2 x B's + 10 mm AND K arm-local elbow peak step <= 2 x B's + 10 mm
quality_criteria.Q4: rig plausibility (elbow flex/hinge): no interior frame near-straight (> 175 deg) and no interior frame bending opposite to A's dominant hinge normal (W129 quality)
quality_criteria.Q5: source-2D fidelity: ONLY if the torso-only affine camera (A, Action 156..215) fits with RMS <= 20 px, K's interior mean 2D left-wrist error <= B's; the input-only fit is recorded here; > 20 px -> camera INVALID, source fidelity UNKNOWN, Q5 cannot pass
quality_criteria.Q6: intended overhead press: K world wrist net rise (Z at 199 minus Z at 172) >= 0.5 x B's net rise (B's rise > 0)
quality_criteria.Q7: agent still-frame review: K judged more natural AND more faithful to the source overhead press than B, and K not named for a flick, wrong elbow or detour
quality_criteria.Q8: native-rate perceptual review of the 30 fps video by a human or an agent that actually perceives playback. This agent cannot perceive playback: declared NOT REVIEWED in advance, so Q8 cannot pass and CASE A is unattainable in this run

raw_rule: raw full-body continuity is UNUSABLE iff (a) any raw elbow (LeftForeArm) or wrist (LeftHand) step in 171->172 .. 199->200 exceeds PROXY_B's step at the same transition by > 100 mm, or (b) any joint group's raw entry (171->172) or exit (199->200) step exceeds PROXY_B's at the same transition by > 100 mm. Raw = the vendor 30-joint posed joints of the returned features (rotation path; numpy 77-joint FK cross-check on the 26 joints unaffected by the vendor relaxed-hand insertion <= 1e-4 m) in the canonical model space (metres, Kimodo SOMA proportions); PROXY_B = the same 30-joint FK of the conditioning clip. NOTE: unlike W137, raw frame 171/200 are the model's own (soft-constrained) poses, not exact copies.
review_protocol: UNBLINDED agent review of fixed-time contact sheets (entry 170-175, middle 183-188, exit 196-201, overview 171..198 step 3) with source crop, A, B, C, D, E, U, T, K; still frames only; written to a review JSON before assess. The 30 fps video is encoded and machine-decoded but NOT perceived at native rate by this agent (Q8 NOT REVIEWED). No human/animator review.

rights.access_judgement: E2 holds ONLY for the vendor's no-text (constraints-only) mode: the vendor code sets the text feature of an empty prompt to zero with zero length, the encoder returns a (B,1,4096) feature, so a null encoder passed through the documented `text_encoder=` parameter yields the identical denoiser input and no Llama weight is requested. Text-conditioned Kimodo remains ACCESS_BLOCKED. This reading is the agent's and is recorded for human review.
